purpose: Use a from-scratch physical transition envelope to choose the offline teacher label for a matched six-expert-to-one-student distillation run.

distinctness.policy_decision: choose the expert action assigned as the student supervision label before distillation
distinctness.separation_from_hf01_hf05: Cm does not rank or intervene on an executed wrist action; it arbitrates offline teacher labels using physical transition targets.
distinctness.separation_from_ref_student: The six-expert/student substrate supplies candidate actions and the student architecture; it supplies no Cm target, checkpoint, or runtime Cm call.

candidate_support.required_action_support: each candidate expert action must be randomized at the same pre-action state
candidate_support.current_task_data_action: read-only audit only; do not collect new transitions

contact_retention_h5.target: mean contact indicator over the next five physical steps

model.decision_uncertainty: contact q10 is the certified lower bound; delta interval radius is the max q90-q10 coordinate span

teacher_arbitration.objective: maximize certified displacement along the object lift axis among candidates passing contact LCB
teacher_arbitration.cm_off: same states, same six expert actions, frozen C1 observation-router teacher label
teacher_arbitration.cm_on_unique_difference: replace only the offline teacher label with the certified Cm candidate; if no candidate passes, use the exact router label
teacher_arbitration.placebo: same-capacity output with candidate labels permuted by a fixed seed

cpu_preflight.must_not_claim: Cm policy utility, held-lift improvement, or causal support
fail_closed_if: candidate expert actions are not randomized at matched states
fit and holdout share an episode
only HF03/HF04 wrist-z support is available

agent_rl_upgrade.stage_1: prepare six-arm randomized pre-action transitions with one-step object motion and five-step contact targets; keep fit/holdout episodes disjoint
agent_rl_upgrade.stage_2: fit the scratch model and report CPU calibration/coverage and arbitration stability; stop on failed support or calibration
agent_rl_upgrade.stage_3: run a matched offline distillation Probe for cm_on, cm_off, and fixed-seed placebo; no online/PPO/collector in this task
agent_rl_upgrade.stage_4: only after a separate Decision Checkpoint may a later matched held-lift validation be considered
